apps.title: Todo Master
apps.subtitle: Today, in order.
apps.description: A to-do manager that reads one plain-language line and sets the due date, priority, and repeat rule from it. Subtasks, today's focus, backup and restore — all inside your browser.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Todo Master screen: the All Tasks board with its progress summary, task rows and the day's schedule panel.

apps.title: Photos
apps.subtitle: A quiet photo library.
apps.description: A photo library that carries the feel of the iOS Photos app. Albums, EXIF details, filter adjustments, a secret album, and member passcode sign-in, all in a single static page.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Photos screen: the library collection with the guest-mode notice above a photo grid.

apps.title: Midpoint
apps.subtitle: Fair meeting point finder.
apps.description: Drop starting points for any group across South Korea. Midpoint calculates the fairest center on NAVER Maps, matches transit hubs and highway ICs, and recommends nearby dining and cafe courses.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Midpoint screen: a NAVER map with a central meeting point between Gangnam and Hongdae, equal 5.63 km distances, and a 100% fairness score.

apps.title: Film Studio
apps.subtitle: Nine films, one browser.
apps.description: A WebGL2 film simulator that develops color through nine original film profiles. Tune 3D LUTs and grain in real time, and your photos never leave the device.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Film Studio screen: a portrait photo developed with the VÆRN heritage-negative profile, beside the nine film signatures and the adjustment panel.

apps.title: Shutterplate
apps.subtitle: Your photo, one studio plate.
apps.description: A browser-local photo frame studio. A photo's EXIF becomes a plate signature, and one of eight signature frames with ten maker emblems turns it into a finished plate — drawn and exported at the photo's own pixel size, with nothing uploaded.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Shutterplate screen: a Sony sample photo framed in the Clean Horizon plate with its EXIF signature, above the thirteen-signature frame library strip.

apps.title: DOS Player
apps.subtitle: Old DOS games, zero install.
apps.description: An instant-play player for classic DOS games and programs, with DOSBox running in the browser through js-dos v8 (WebAssembly). Boot Digger, shareware DOOM or the Dhrystone 2 benchmark in one click, or drop in your own .jsdos bundle. Fullscreen, sound and a touch gamepad are built in, and your files stay on device.
apps.thumbnailAlt: DOS Player screen: shareware DOOM running on its main menu inside the player, beside the instant-play library of Digger, DOOM and Dhrystone 2.

apps.title: HD2Markdown Viewer
apps.subtitle: Read it as written.
apps.description: A read-only Markdown viewer that runs entirely in the browser. YAML frontmatter folds into a five-field card, a heading-based table of contents walks the document, code blocks copy in one click, and URL loading, compressed share links and print/PDF export finish the job — every rendered document sanitized.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Markdown Viewer screen: the sample document's title with its tag chips above an expanded five-field frontmatter card, beside the contents list.

apps.title: Machine Learning Lab
apps.subtitle: Learn by experiment.
apps.description: A machine-learning study site that runs across seven chapters and five labs. Concepts, calculations, comparison diagrams, and notebooks, practiced right in the browser.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Machine Learning Lab screen: the study site cover with data, model, and experiment diagrams.

apps.title: Vektra Vár
apps.subtitle: Objects, seen on your device.
apps.description: A client-side object-detection studio. YOLO11n looks at photos, a playing video, or a live webcam frame inside the browser, draws the COCO 80 boxes, and exports the annotated PNG or the raw JSON coordinates. Nothing is uploaded.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Vektra Vár screen: a street photo under purple car and red person boxes, with confidence, IoU and COCO class controls on the right.

apps.title: Vísna Sól
apps.subtitle: Git, Python, Linux and SQL by typing.
apps.description: A coding sandbox in a VS Code-style IDE that runs entirely in the browser. Practise Git commands against a live commit graph, run real Python through Pyodide, work a POSIX-ish shell over a virtual file system, and query SQLite — twenty guided missions across four tracks, nothing uploaded.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Vísna Sól screen: the Git track's VS Code-style workspace — explorer and mission list left, editor and terminal centre, and the mission card above a four-commit graph on the right.

apps.title: Hlýja Hljóm
apps.subtitle: Every codec, straight from your disk.
apps.description: An all-codec music player for the files already on your machine. Browsers decode MP3, AAC, FLAC, WAV, OGG and Opus; ffmpeg.wasm converts WMA, APE, AC-3, DTS, AIFF and ALAC inside the tab. 10-band EQ, synced .lrc lyrics, gapless and crossfade transitions, an IndexedDB library.
apps.thumbnailAlt: Hlýja Hljóm playing a tagged MP3: the console shows its cover art, codec and engine chips and the transport, with the open buttons and library on the right.
